# Solar Textures attribution

Surface and cloud maps, Sun, Moon and Saturn ring texture by **Solar System Scope / INOVE**.

Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/
License: **CC BY 4.0**, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Original downloads: `https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/<filename>`.
Files are distributed unchanged. This application adjusts lighting, tint, cloud transparency and atmospheric effects at render time.

Earth follows the source's actual geographic map. Some other satellite surfaces reuse the Moon image as a stylized placeholder. This credit and license link are also displayed in the application's help dialog. Preserve them when redistributing.

Additional scientific data sources and approximation limits: repository `docs/SOURCES.md`.
